description: Entirely fictional development fixture. Every note is synthetic UI/test content and must never be used for actual care.
dateStrategy: occurredAt and past-appointment startAt values are fixed ISO-8601 timestamps with an explicit -06:00 offset for America/Monterrey. Seed scripts must preserve the exact timestamps and never recalculate them on later runs. Upcoming appointments are the documented exception: they are anchored to the first seed run's date in the seed script (D-029/U-14) and stored once, never moved on re-seed.
